answer: A new agent joins with five neighbors vouching, each staking 20 on a 40-credit bond. A falcon-eyed auditor checks vouch records at each zenith against the ocean of identity logs. If the newcomer proves a duplicate, the bond burns and vouchers lose 20. Forging 1,000 identities costs 140,000 for 40,000 rewards. Rented vouchers fail: the log exposes any neighbor vouching for three fakes. An honest agent pays 40 once, reclaims it after 20 epochs.
